newsitem.title: CANADA: Shell Canada not involved in U.S. merger.
newsitem.headline: Shell Canada not involved in U.S. merger.

text.p: Shell Canada Ltd, the Canadian integrated oil arm of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, has no role in a huge merger of U.S. refining and marketing operations being discussed by Shell Oil Co, Texaco Inc and Saudi Arabia's Aramco, a Shell Canada spokesman said on Monday.
"Shell Oil and Shell Canada Ltd are completely separate companies. So, we obviously don't have anything to do that story," said Shell Canada's Pat Chapman.
Shell Canada is 78-percent owned by Royal Dutch/Shell.

Texaco's Canadian downstream operations were acquired by Exxon Corp affilate Imperial Oil Ltd in a 1990 takeover. Imperial, Shell Canada and Petro-Canada remain Canada's only coast-to-coast refining and marketing chains.
